row:
This channel is empowering people by educating them about health, exercises and nutrition

Jasper Hulscher is a qualified physiotherapist as well as a chiropractor. He has created a unique treatment protocol for musculoskeletal problems in which he combines his knowledge as a physiotherapist with the knowledge he gained as a chiropractor. 

He currently runs two clinics, Fornham Chiropractic Clinic which is located on the outskirts of Bury St Edmunds and Milton Chiropractic Clinic, located on the outskirts of Cambridge, United Kingdom.


Please Read The Disclaimer on our website: https://www.miltonchiropractic.co.uk/youtube-disclaimer/
